purpose: Expose actual executed operator/source provenance and test recovery teaching on frozen train-only mistakes. Full M1 contract unchanged; this is a mechanism study, not a milestone certificate.

Structural keys identify supplied expression graphs, commuting only supplied +/*. If a noncanonical prefix already contains the target graph, teach DONE on its actual register; otherwise append missing canonical subgraphs in provided topological order within existing8-action quota. No state contains a future result. Deduplicate exact input/target pairs per question, retain first3000 additional pairs globally; record all skipped/refused cases. Practice control repeats canonical state min(actual-register-count,canonical-last-index) for each selected repair. All4 fits have identical counts/order, not identical inputs/labels/parameter shapes.
representation: New explicit working and blind module IDs with unchanged AXRP0001/tag19 model codec. Frame is normalized original question followed by four tokens per computed register: operator, left origin, right origin, actual scalar. Blind substitutes work/left/right at same positions. No future teacher states in autonomous execution. Provenance is an engineered interface, not emergent discovery. Legacy comparison additionally changes clock/layout; only working versus blind isolates provenance metadata.
